test(mission): make the aborted-writer drift guard actually guard (J2)

  a WATCHED file also passed undetected -- its parent node is
  *ast.KeyValueExpr, outside the narrower write-position set;
- a package-level var alias and any writer under cmd/ (unscanned
  entirely) were both missed by construction, unverified but implied
  by the same gaps.

Rewrote the scan: filepath.WalkDir over internal/ and cmd/, skipping
_test.go, replaces the hardcoded file list; *ast.KeyValueExpr (composite-
literal field values) and *ast.ValueSpec (var/const initializers) join
the write-position set. All three of the reviewer's exact falsifying
scenarios (new-file writer, composite-literal writer, cmd/-tree writer,
plus a package-level var alias) were reproduced via temporary probe
files/edits and confirmed caught before this commit, then removed.

Also cross-referenced the guard from countBlockingDelegations's own
doc comment (store.go) -- the "exactly three call sites" claim
previously had no mention that anything enforces it.
EOF
)"
